sourceChars: gemini-3.6-flash paid-tier pricing used for margin evaluation: Base Input $1.50 / MTok; Cache Hits $0.15 / MTok; Output $7.50 / MTok. Gemini implicit caching bills no separate cache-write; cache creation is conservatively charged at the base input rate as an upper bound. Rates recorded 2026-07-25 in docs/operations/serving-engine-cost-20260725.md (engine pricing table row: gemini-3.6-flash (paid) | $1.50 | $0.15 | $7.50 | trains: no) from the Google AI developer pricing page for the paid tier, which does not train on submitted content.
